summary: Diane Howard voted against Redwood City's March 2024 ceasefire resolution, arguing it could deepen local divisions and that international affairs fell outside the council's role. Her jurisdictional framing declined to address the military campaign in Gaza, leaving the council without a public position on the ongoing violence. CAIR-SFBA's tracker corroborated the vote while noting it is not a verified roll-call transcript.
